meta.title: DaVinci Resolve bridge
meta.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to DaVinci Resolve Studio: 36 tools for environment checks, media archiving, timeline editing, color nodes with LUT/DRX, Fusion comps, and the Deliver queue. Bulk writes save the project and duplicate the timeline first.

pythonPath.label: Python interpreter
pythonPath.description: Leave empty to auto-detect (.venv, then python, then python3). Set an absolute python.exe path when needed.

toolTimeoutMs.label: Tool timeout (ms)
toolTimeoutMs.description: Longest wait for one Resolve operation. Render jobs should stay at three minutes or more.

startupTimeoutMs.label: Bridge startup timeout (ms)
startupTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the Python bridge on first start; the first dependency import is slower.

failOnStartupError.label: Block plugin load when the bridge fails
failOnStartupError.description: When off, a failed bridge only means no tools, and never delays DSH startup.

enabled.label: Enable plugin
enabled.description: Turning this off removes every tool immediately while the plugin stays installed.

tools.qing_media_import_folder: Import a folder into the media pool
tools.qing_color_set_lut: Apply a 3D LUT to a node
tools.qing_color_grab_frame: Export the current frame for review
tools.qing_deliver_setup_job: Configure and queue a render job
